notes: Malik appears twice in the text: the first «حدثنا مالك» (co-transmitter with al-Harith, both from Ibn al-Qasim) and the second «قال حدثنا مالك» (Ibn al-Qasim's teacher); both kept
«- واللفظ له -» is a gloss, left out
the apposition «ابنى عبد الله بن عمر» describes Hamza and Salim and is not a name for either: left out
Ibn Umar relays the Prophet's words and is the last link
